title: Erase a disk and remove all partitions
summary: Reformat a disk or volume using a specific partition scheme (like GPT) and delete all existing partitions. This erases all data on the selected device.

steps.explain: Reformat the specified disk device with the chosen partition scheme (e.g., GPT) and set the number of partitions to 0, effectively erasing all data and partition structures.

placeholders.name: DISK_DEVICE
placeholders.description: The identifier of the disk to erase (e.g., /dev/disk2).

placeholders.name: PARTITION_SCHEME
placeholders.description: The partition scheme to use: APM, MBR, or GPT.

warnings: This command will permanently erase all data on the specified disk.
Ensure you have selected the correct disk identifier to avoid data loss on other drives.

rollback.explain: Data erased by this command cannot be recovered using standard tools. Restore from a backup if available.
